about: Engine fixes found by research rounds (public companies, no portfolio data). Read by fundamental_engine/learning.py: fixes per company researched should fall over time if the engine is learning. kind: engine_bug (wrong result from the engine), missing_input (a pattern the engine could not express; now an evidenced input), classification, data_gap (data the collectors did not bring).

fixes.finding: 5-for-1 split of December 2025 read as 72.8% share issuance
fixes.fix: issuer split tag (StockholdersEquityNoteStockSplitConversionRatio1) read as a dated corporate action; weighted-average shares restated for splits

fixes.finding: analysis TypeError when a weighted-average share count was missing
fixes.fix: conditional restatement

fixes.finding: no consensus in the structured feeds
fixes.fix: consensus read from public pages (web__consensus-estimates__annual.json), dated at retrieval

fixes.finding: 3-for-1 split of 2 April 2026 placed after the 31 March count, which the 10-Q had already restated; the real 3x step left unresolved
fixes.fix: dataqa: a split up to 92 days after a count filed after the split belongs to the step into that count; a dated split counts only for a step it explains

fixes.finding: SIC 3613 (switchgear) matched no label: unclassified
fixes.fix: SIC 3610-3629 falls back to industrial

fixes.finding: an evidenced 'structural' cycle reading was silently ignored when the model card had normalized the cycle from the history
fixes.fix: the analyst's evidenced treatment governs, with a warning and a material issue for the reviewer; the forecast reports the routed method

fixes.finding: debt 17.1bn instead of 10.6bn: LongTermDebt (the total) plus its current portion
fixes.fix: a noncurrent line under another tag (LongTermLoansPayable) that adds up with the current portion to the LongTermDebt tag settles the tag as the total (dataqa and the annual table)

fixes.finding: deposit and securitization funding of the credit book, whose interest is in cost of revenue, was subtracted again as debt
fixes.fix: inputs.forecast.operating_funding (evidenced), with a warning when reinvestment is not measured net of it

fixes.finding: a $258m licence sale in revenue and a $698m acquired-R&D charge started the forecast at -33% margin on a falling revenue base
fixes.fix: inputs.forecast.nonrecurring: evidenced one-offs of listed kinds removed from fiscal years, TTM and year to date; recurring costs cannot be removed

fixes.finding: royalty financing obligation ($427m) outside the bridge; its interest made the term loan look 20%
fixes.fix: inputs.forecast.debt_like_claims added to opening debt

fixes.finding: valuation crashed: release-bounded terminal ROIC 167%
fixes.fix: terminal ROIC capped at 100%

fixes.finding: what_must_be_true reported 'not reachable' when one end of the search was unfunded or invalid
fixes.fix: bisection on validity moves the end to the edge of the valid domain

fixes.finding: foreign filer: half-year results only in a 6-K press release, TTM 10 months stale
fixes.fix: H1 statements loaded through the evidence bundle from the 6-K exhibit (primary document)

fixes.finding: 2-for-1 split of 3.9.2026 came after the last filed count (28.7.2026): the post-split quote was divided by the pre-split count, doubling value per share ($121 shown instead of about $60; 'attractive' instead of 'expensive'). MNST (3-for-1) had the same error in the large-cap run.
fixes.fix: IBKR corporate actions loaded as dated splits; a split after a count published before it restates the count; the listing's market cap off by a split factor makes the share count a conflict (blocks) when no dated split explains it

fixes.finding: current maturities ($1.6bn) missed: the current-portion tag LongTermDebtAndCapitalLeaseObligationsCurrent was not mapped
fixes.fix: tag mapped; the filer's total including current maturities settles the scope of the long-term debt tag

fixes.finding: long-term debt under issuer tags not read: net debt $3bn instead of about $80bn, a false +74% upside
fixes.fix: interest expense above 25% of the debt found is a held material issue (debt_incomplete): no value shown, excluded from ranked lists until the debt is supplied

fixes.finding: SEC companyfacts did not yet carry the 10-Q filed 28.7.2026: balance sheet and TTM 7 months old
fixes.fix: H1 statements loaded from the 8-K exhibit through the evidence bundle

fixes.finding: minority interests (CHTR $6.9bn incl. redeemable, THC $4.0bn and $423m a year of income) are not deducted from equity value; with Charter's equity at 12% of EV and 3% perpetual growth on shrinking revenue the screen showed +396%
fixes.fix: open: add noncontrolling interests to the bridge

fixes.finding: nitrogen fertilizer typed industrial (not commodity) at a cyclical peak: +171%
fixes.fix: open: classification of fertilizer producers

fixes.finding: finance lease liabilities ($13.5bn) outside the bridge while their payments are not operating costs
fixes.fix: debt_like_claims kind finance_leases

fixes.finding: private AI stakes (Anthropic about $190bn, OpenAI $50bn at Amazon's own Level 3 carrying values, about $22 a share) are excluded from the bridge by policy; reported beside the value, not in it
fixes.fix: open: an evidenced non_operating_assets input with a mandatory haircut

fixes.finding: 'acquisitions, net of cash acquired, non-marketable investments, and other' ($39.8bn, mostly OpenAI and Anthropic stock) read as an acquisition: anchor_includes_acquired_revenue warning without acquired revenue
fixes.fix: open: separate investment purchases from business acquisitions

fixes.finding: owner challenge: Amazon 'worth $160' at $262. Across 330 clean casefiles 87% sat below price (median -47%): values were discounted at the engine's own cost of equity (cap-weighted 9.68%) while the engine prices the market at 6.87%; the calibrated index existed but was not passed in research runs, and the hurdle never goes below the model's own cost of equity
fixes.fix: calibration records the market cost of equity and the gap; decision reports a market-consistent value and the edge over the market's implied return; START_HERE requires the calibrated index

fixes.finding: business-risk add-ons only add: value-weighted +0.93pp (calibration weights) over risk-free + ERP on the 481-company sweep, against the ERP's own definition (the market's average company earns rf + ERP)
fixes.fix: forecast.MARKET_NEUTRAL_ADJUSTMENT row (-1pp); calibration reports mean_risk_adjustment after each sweep

fixes.finding: research runs used the undated 4.25% risk-free and 4.50% ERP defaults; on 19.10.2026 the 10-year Treasury was 5.15% and Damodaran's implied ERP (1.10) 4.20%
fixes.fix: deep --market FILE (handoff.with_market_inputs): dated risk-free (USD reporters) and ERP for every company

fixes.finding: without a moat assessment terminal ROIC faded to Ku+2pp whatever the company earned (Amazon 21.4% -> 11.75%); HOLT data keep about half of the excess over ten years
fixes.fix: forecast.EXCESS_RETURN_PERSISTENCE: base keeps 50%, bull 71% of the demonstrated excess (bear and weak moat unchanged)

fixes.finding: no outside view: nothing said how rare the growth in a forecast or a price is for a company of that size
fixes.fix: base_rates.py (Base Rate Book exhibit 4) on every USD forecast and on the price-implied growth

fixes.finding: Base Rate Book exhibit 4, $325-700m class: printed percentages sum to 92% in every column
fixes.fix: class rebuilt from the appendix observation counts; a test checks that every row is a distribution
